tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one material everything is made of: page background AND the fill of raised cards, buttons and toggles. Never put a different fill under a raised element.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields, slider tracks, pressed states. Pair with shadow-inset-sm or shadow-pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-light
tokens.usage: Highlight side of every extrusion (top-left light source). Only used inside shadow tokens and the cover.

tokens.name: shadow-dark
tokens.usage: Shade side of every extrusion (bottom-right). Only used inside shadow tokens and the cover.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-sunken (10.3:1 light, 11.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions on surface and surface-sunken (≥4.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control outlines and placeholder-free field borders where shadows alone are not enough. 3.2:1 on surface (light). Falls to 2.9:1 on surface-sunken in light: do not draw it inside a well.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The single hue: primary button fill, active toggle knob track, selected states. Fill only; text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (4.7:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and links on surface or surface-sunken (≥4.6:1). Use this, never accent, for text in light theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring offset 3px around any interactive element. Mandatory: shadows do not signal focus.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface and surface-sunken (≥5.2:1 light, ≥6.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, error field outline, destructive actions, on surface (≥5:1).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero numbers and page titles. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. Weight 500, not 400: thin strokes vanish on a low-contrast surface.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, toggle inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding, field padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding. Raised elements need at least this much air around them or the shadows collide.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Toggles, pill buttons, avatars.

shadow.note: Two shadows per extrusion: shadow-dark down-right, shadow-light up-left, from a fixed top-left light. Raised = outward, pressed = inset. Only on elements whose fill is surface.

tokens.name: raised-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, toggle knobs.

tokens.name: raised-md
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: raised-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, dialogs. One per screen.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Active/pressed button, selected segment.

tokens.name: inset-sm
tokens.usage: Input wells, toggle tracks.
